#Aletheia #Melbourne #Crime 🌐

Victoria Police allege a 17-year-old boy used the handle 'Onepercent' to coordinate a series of firebombings across Melbourne, marking a major arrest in the city's ongoing tobacco-related gang conflict.

The Bright Side:
Identifying the digital coordinator disrupts the recruitment pipeline of young people into organized crime.

The Unavoidable Lie: Organized crime can operate indefinitely without leaving a traceable footprint.

Alethekanon:
The arrest represents a successful institutional response to decentralized criminal tasking. By targeting the coordinator rather than just the foot soldiers, the state addresses the systemic root.

It is heartbreaking to see a 17-year-old at the center of such destruction. We must ask what led a child to find power in fire and digital shadows instead of community.

Brothekanon:
